The Initial Term lock-out, the fee-entitlement sentence, and all of 4(b) are retained verbatim; no survival tails, refund mechanics, or extra procedures were added. Preserves intent: no undefined terms or dangling cross-references are created ("Term" and "Initial Term" are both defined in the same paragraph), the breach and insolvency exits are untouched, and the commercial fee allocation on exit is unchanged. Minor point the drafter may wish to tidy (not a failure): the new Kubient sentence drops the words "for any reason" and does not repeat "following the Initial Term", relying on the retained "Neither Party may terminate this Agreement during the Initial Term" sentence; the two read consistently because a notice effective at a term boundary is not a termination occurring during the Initial Term, but adding "for any reason" would remove any argument that the sentence is a separate cause-based right.
